notes.title: Super Cabbage Kabumi Demo Update v 0.5.5 (BIG UPDATE)
notes.content: [p]-Super Cabbage Kabumi now supports multiple languages! Play in English, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Russian, Japanese, and Korean![/p][p]-Introducing Item Elements!  Items now have an elemental type.  Certain items and perks get bonuses from having different elemental types in your inventory, like the Insect Queen who gets an extreme bonk bonus from having her minions by her side, or the Geology perk that builds a floor from your earth items![/p][p]-5 new items and 5 new perks to try out in the demo!! Slice through cabbages with the shuriken and create a floating armada with the bubble wand![/p]

notes.title: Demo v 0.4.2 Update
notes.content:
[p]Small update today![/p][p][/p][p]-Added a new Apocrypha book to the library, Combinatrics.  You can unlock this after unlocking all your item slots in a run[/p][p][/p][p]-Drinking boba tea in the shop now gives you an extra ball on the next cabbage patch.  Previously it would just do nothing if you ate it outside of a cabbage patch.[/p][p][/p][p]-Made overworld navigation more intuitive.  Clicking on doors now brings you to the front of the shop.  Shop triggers won't activate if you click far enough away from them, preventing you from entering the appearance shop when you tried to go to the name card shop

-Fixed a bug where the rocket weapon would launch slower on lower framerates[/p][p]
-Changed cabbage spawning logic to prevent overlaps on cabbage spawns which could sometimes cause random score spikes.[/p][p]
-Improved visuals for Dice triggers so it is more obvious when the dice trigger an item[/p]
